title: Three Qwen models added for code, reasoning, and vision
summary:
Three Qwen models joined the API, broken model backends left the registry, and the Greenhouse grew by two apps.

Alibaba DashScope support adds three paid-only text API models: `qwen-coder-large` for code generation, `qwen-large` for reasoning with a 1,048,576-token context, and `qwen-vision` for text-and-image input. All three support tools.

Models backed by four broken providers were removed from the shared registry, along with their aliases and generation handlers. The cleanup spans text, image, video, and audio models, so those options are no longer listed or routed for generation.

The catalog added LND Ai for image generation and Practica un segundo idioma for language-learning exercises, bringing the Greenhouse to 1,129 apps. A README update also credits app creators by name in the Recent Apps table.

daily.title: Qwen reads images
daily.text: Send text and images to `qwen-vision`, a reasoning model with a 131,072-token context and tool support. This model is paid-only. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=qwen-vision).
